biological.citation: SATB2 preserves colon stem cell identity and mediates ileum-colon conversion via enhancer remodeling (PMID: 34582804)
biological.summary: SATB2 is a colon-restricted chromatin factor that singularly preserves LGR5+ adult colonic stem cell and epithelial identity. Satb2 loss in adult mice leads to stable conversion of colonic stem cells into ileal-like stem cells and replacement of colonic mucosa with ileum-like tissue. SATB2 regulates colonic identity by modulating enhancer binding of CDX2 and HNF4A transcription factors.

biological.citation: Astrocyte layers in the mammalian cerebral cortex revealed by a single-cell in situ transcriptomic map (PMID: 32203496)
biological.summary: Satb2 mutations that shifted neuronal post-mitotic development were sufficient to alter glial layering in the cerebral cortex, indicating an instructive role for neuronal cues in organizing astrocyte layers. Satb2 expression patterns were identified in spatial transcriptomic analysis of cortical organization.

biological.citation: ARID1B controls transcriptional programs of axon projection in an organoid model of the human corpus callosum (PMID: 38718796)
biological.summary: SATB2+ neurons (callosal projection neurons) show impaired maturation in ARID1B+/- neural organoids. SATB2 is identified as a determinant of callosal projection neuron identity, and its dysregulation impairs long-range axonal projections and corpus callosum development.

biological.citation: A critical period of translational control during brain development at codon resolution (PMID: 36482253)
biological.summary: Satb2 is identified as a chromatin-binding protein whose translation is upregulated during mid-gestation in mouse neocortex neurogenesis. Timed translation upregulation of Satb2 is essential for neuronal subtype differentiation and restricts protein expression in neuronal lineages despite broad transcriptional priming in progenitors.

biological.citation: SATB2 Mediates H3K9 Delactylation by Recruiting HDAC3 to Repress LCN2 and Inhibit Lung Tumor Growth and Metastasis (PMID: 41736683)
biological.summary: SATB2 functions as a tumor suppressor in NSCLC by acting as a negative regulator of global histone lactylation. SATB2 binds the LCN2 promoter and recruits HDAC3 via its N-terminal domain to catalyze H3K9 delactylation and repress LCN2 transcription, impairing cell proliferation, migration, invasion, and EMT.

biological.citation: Protein translation rate determines neocortical neuron fate (PMID: 38849354)
biological.summary: Ire1α regulates Satb2 expression and neuronal polarity in developing brain. Satb2 mRNA translation requires eIF4A1 helicase activity towards its 5'-untranslated region. Satb2 translation rates are inherent features of cortical neuron subtypes and determine neuronal identity.

biological.citation: APOE4 impacts cortical neurodevelopment and alters network formation in human brain organoids (PMID: 39416105)
biological.summary: APOE4 decreased SATB2+ cortical neurons in iPSC-derived cortical organoids, increased astrocytes and outer radial glia, and was associated with increased cell death and dysregulated GABA-related gene expression.
biological.sample_size: iPSC-derived cortical and ganglionic eminence organoids

biological.citation: YAP-Activated SATB2 Is a Coactivator of NRF2 That Amplifies Antioxidative Capacity and Promotes Tumor Progression in Renal Cell Carcinoma (PMID: 36598364)
biological.summary: SATB2 is upregulated in RCC and acts as an oncogenic chromatin organizer. YAP/TEAD4 activates SATB2 expression, and SATB2 coordinates with NRF2 to drive enhancer-promoter interactions and amplify transcriptional activity of antioxidative stress genes. SATB2 recruits SWI/SNF complex subunits (BRD7, BRG1) to sustain DNA accessibility.
biological.sample_size: RCC cell lines, patient-derived xenografts, and organoids

biological.citation: ASHG 2023 - Extensive profiling of transcription factors in postmortem brains defines genomic occupancy in disease relevant cell types and links TF activities to neuropsychiatric disorders
biological.summary: SATB2 is identified as a neuronal transcription factor with unique genomic occupancy profiles across brain regions. SATB2 binds unique elements that regulate neuron-specific gene expression. ChIP-seq for SATB2 in neuron-enriched NeuN+ sorted nuclei shows enrichment for neuropsychiatric disease variants.
biological.sample_size: 1,072 ChIP-seq experiments from human postmortem brain

biological.citation: ASHG 2022 - AlphaCluster: Coevolutionary driven residue-residue interaction models enable quantifiable clustering analysis of de novo variants to enhance predictions of pathogenicity
biological.summary: SATB2 is newly implicated at the genome-wide level in autism spectrum disorder through clustering analysis of de novo missense variants using AlphaCluster, a statistical method that maps missense residues onto protein tertiary structure.
